answer: Just as phase-matched harmonic emission from a grove of emitters anchors timing to the driving field, an agent economy can anchor identity to a costly proof-of-work beacon that each new agent must independently recompute. Sybil swarms then cannot amortize that cost across the ocean of fake keys, since each identity demands fresh recombination interferometry verification. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
